rows.en:
Well, since we already know where we're headed,
let's go straight to that shop.
We should be there any minute now...
rows.notes: Pinon, female scene; she is being swept along by the crowd.

rows.en:
Then let's hurry a little.
With this many people around,
we could easily get separated...
(So it's MY fault...)
rows.notes: Female. Answers Pinon scolding the player for wandering off and getting lost, when she was the one who got lost.

rows.en:
So I have no choice... No choice at all, got it?!
I suppose I could hold your hand
so we don't get separated...
rows.notes: Pinon, female scene. Grudging offer (te o tsunaide yatte mo ii).

rows.en:
(Umm, I can take that to mean
she wants me to hold her hand, right?)

Yeah, good idea.
Then maybe I'll have you hold my hand
so we don't get separated.
rows.notes: Female; plays along with Pinon's face-saving framing.

rows.en: Hehe, come on, let's go.

I'm so glad you got a cute ribbon,
Pinon-chan.

For something like this,
I'll tag along anytime.

(Looks like Pinon-chan got what she wanted,
so I'm glad today turned into a fun shopping trip.)

(If we ever go shopping again,
I'll have to hold the princess's hand tight
so I don't lose her.)
rows.notes: Female. himesama: the player called Pinon 'Princess' earlier in the scene ('Then, Princess, may I have your hand'); 'the princess' should match the male twin c12140 (slice 165).

rows.en:
(Today I'm going to have fun shopping
with Pinon-chan in the Shibuya Area!)

The Shibuya Area really is crowded
on days off...
So, uh, \p...
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; awkward lead-in to asking to hold hands.

rows.en: Hm? What's wrong, Pinon-chan?

So...
so we don't get separated like last time,
I suppose I could hold your hand...

Heh, good idea.
Let's hold hands, then.
It's only because I have to, got it?!
Haha, okay, okay.

(Shopping hand in hand with Pinon-chan
like this isn't so bad.)

(Today I'm going to have fun shopping
with Pinon-chan in the Shibuya Area!)

Hehe, good idea.
Let's hold hands, then.
Hehe, okay, okay.

(Shopping hand in hand with Pinon-chan
like this isn't so bad.)

(Pinon-chan wants to take a walk in Central Park?
That's an unusual invitation, coming from her.)
(Huh? Pinon-chan's already here?)
Heyyy, Pino...
rows.notes: Player, both genders; cut off mid-name.

rows.en: Ooh, there, there~
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; petting a cat.

rows.en:
(Hm? Oh, she's playing with a cat.
Then I'll join in too...)
Where did you come from, nya~?

Did you come here all by yourself, nya~?
What did you come here for, nya~?

(Huh... Uhh...
That IS Pinon-chan, right...?)

(Y-yeah...
For some reason I'm seeing phantom cat ears
on her head, but that's definitely Pinon-chan...)
You're... just so cute, nya~~!!
(For now, I'll pretend I didn't see this...)
(Ah!)
rows.notes: Player, both genders; gives themselves away.

rows.en: Who's there, nya?!
......H-hey there, Pinon-chan...

rows.notes: x4: Pinon here (both genders), Hoshimura on the phone in frd_yui_006 (both genders).

rows.en: ......How much did you see?
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. dokokara mite ta = from what point were you watching.

rows.en:
Wow, the weather's really nice today, huh?
A walk on a day like this is just...
How much did you see?!
I-I just got here!!
rows.notes: Player, both genders (polite desu in a panic).
x4: the player here (lets it slip, both genders) and in frd_pnn_008, where the player teases Pinon with it.

rows.en:
Th-that's not it! This is, um,
nyow do I put it...!!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders. Pun: nyante iu ka (nante iu ka with nya); kept as 'nyow'.

rows.en:
J-just calm down for a sec,
Pinon-chan!

Pinon-chan...
There's no need to be so embarrassed.

You were super cute going 'nya~, nya~',
Pinon-chan. So don't be shy,
have more confidence in yourself...
Pinon-chan?
Waaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; runs off crying.

rows.en: Ah! Pinon-chan...
(She ran off like a shot...)
(She didn't have to be THAT embarrassed, nya~)
(Whoops, I caught Pinon-chan's habit...)

(Pinon-chan wants to take a walk in Central Park?
That's an unusual invitation, coming from her.)
(Huh? Pinon-chan's already here?)

(Hm? Oh, she's playing with a cat.
Then I'll join in too...)

(Huh... Uhh...
That IS Pinon-chan, right...?)

(Y-yeah...
For some reason I'm seeing phantom cat ears
on her head, but that's definitely Pinon-chan...)

Wow, the weather's really nice today, isn't it?
A walk on a day like this is just...

Pinon-chan...
There's no need to be so embarrassed.

You were super cute going 'nya~, nya~',
Pinon-chan. So don't be shy,
have more confidence in yourself...
(She ran off like a shot...)
(Whoops, I caught Pinon-chan's habit...)

(Hmm, I came to Central Park by myself,
but there's nothing to do. I'm bored...)
(I know, maybe I'll call Pinon-chan.)
Hello, this is Pinon.
rows.notes: Pinon on the phone, both genders.

rows.en: Oh, Pinon-chan.
rows.notes: x6: the player here, and in nml_pnn_015 and nml_pnn_021 (both genders) as a reaction to Pinon.

rows.en:
Oh, it's \p...
What on earth do you want with me?

I'm at Central Park right now, so I was
wondering if you'd like to come too,
if you're free...

Central Park?!
I am NOT going! Absolutely not!!
Bye!
rows.notes: Pinon, both genders; still mortified about the cat scene.

rows.en: Ah, Pinon-chan...
rows.notes: x6: the player as Pinon hangs up or leaves; also nml_pnn_001 and nml_pnn_007 (both genders).

rows.en:
(Maybe she's still hung up
on what happened last time...)

(Hmm, I came to Central Park by myself,
but there's nothing to do. I'm bored...)

I'm at Central Park right now, so I was
wondering if you'd like to come too,
if you're free...

uncertain: c12154: 'the princess' for himesama (the player's teasing name for Pinon earlier in frd_pnn_004); should match the male twin c12140 in slice 165.
